note.ja: 中性周期Coulombの直接EwaldとB-spline SPME、2次元自由空間対数FMM、静止イオン背景の1次元cold-plasma PIC、等質Maxwell分子の衝突round、定常純吸収平板を別々の固定入力で調べます。旧版と追加版の参照・打切り/格子/刻み収束・保存量・seed不確かさを区別します。原Lagrange PME、3次元Coulomb FMM、Landau減衰、物理時間の空間DSMC、散乱放射輸送の実装や分野間連成の証拠へ広げません。
note.en: Use separate fixed inputs for neutral periodic direct Ewald/B-spline SPME, 2D free-space logarithmic FMM, 1D cold-plasma PIC with stationary ions, homogeneous Maxwell-molecule collision rounds and a steady pure-absorption slab. Distinguish historical and companion references, cutoff/mesh/time refinement, conservation and seed uncertainty. This supplies no implementation evidence for original Lagrange PME, 3D Coulomb FMM, Landau damping, physical-time spatial DSMC, scattering radiation transport or cross-field coupling.
